rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING PARENTS TO PLANT TWO (2) TREES FOR EVERY CHILD BORN TO THEM
rows.title_short: Requiring Parents To Plant Two (2) Trees For Every Child Born To Them
rows.abstract:
Mandates all parents, whether legally married or not, to plant two (2) trees for every child born to them which shall be a requirement for the release of the child´s Certificate of Live Birth.

States that planted species should be appropriate to the location, climate and topography of the area where they reside with preference for indigenous species and high value crops.

rows.abstract:
Aims to require graduating students from grade school, high school, and college to plant at least ten (10) trees as a mandatory prerequisite for their graduation which shall be their living legacy to the environment and to the future generations.

States that the planted trees should be appropriate to the location, climate and topography of the area with preference for the planting of indigenous species.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A COMPREHENSIVE NUCLEAR REGULATORY FRAMEWORK, CREATING FOR THE PURPOSE, THE PHILIPPINE NUCLEAR REGULATORY COMMISSION, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Providing For A Comprehensive Nuclear Regulatory Framework, Creating For The Purpose, The Philippine Nuclear Regulatory Commission
rows.abstract:
Provides for a comprehensive nuclear regulatory framework that shall protect public health and safety and the environment against the harmful effects of ionizing radiation, and for the safety and security of radiation sources.

Seeks to create the Philippine Nuclear Regulatory Commission (PNRC) which shall exercise authority on the safety, security and safeguards involving the peaceful uses of nuclear materials and other radioactive materials, facilities and radiation generating equipment. 

Provides for the regulation and authorization of nuclear installations and radiation facilities, radiation protection, emergency preparedness and response plan, transport of nuclear and other radioactive material, import and export of nuclear and other radioactive materials , management of spent nuclear fuel, and safeguards, physical protection and security of nuclear materials.

Includes provisions for civil liability for nuclear and radiation damage as well as penalties for violation.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2019-01-14, transmitted to the Senate on 2019-01-15 and received by the Senate on 2019-01-15

rows.title_short: Increasing The Benefits Granted To Science And Technology ( S & T) Personnel Of The Government, Amending For The Purpose Republic Act No. 8439
rows.abstract:
Seeks to remove the limitations on additional salary and honoraria for science and technology practitioners and allow non-DOST S&T personnel to avail of the benefits under this Act on certain conditions.

Allows scientist who is due for compulsory retirement to extend his services for a maximum of five (5) years provided that the scientist is still mentally and physically fit and the research project is within the priority research and development programs of the DOST and is identified as strategic to national development as certified by the DOST Secretary.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE BENEFITS FROM SERVICE CHARGES OF RANK-AND-FILE AND SUPERVISORY EMPLOYEES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 96 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: Increasing The Benefits From Service Charges Of Rank-and- File And Supervisory Employees
rows.abstract:
Provides that all service charges collected by hotels, restaurants and similar establishments shall be distributed from the rate of 85% to 90% for all regular rank and file and supervisory employees, and from 15% to 10% for the management to cover pilferages and breakages, and for distribution to local managerial employees.

Mandates that in case the minimum wage is increased by law or wage order, service charges paid to the covered employees shall not be considered in determining the employer´s compliance with the increased minimum wage.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11360 enacted on 2019-08-07

rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING GENDER-BASED STREET, PUBLIC SPACES AND ONLINE SEXUAL HARASSMENT, PROVIDING PROTECTIVE MEASURES AND PRESCRIBING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Defining Gender- Based Street, Public Spaces And Online Sexual Harassment, Providing Protective Measures And Prescribing Penalties Therefor
rows.abstract:
Prescribes for the acts that constitute gender-based street and public spaces harassment such as catcalling, wolf-whistling, unwanted invitations, misogynistic and sexist slurs, persistent uninvited comments or gestures on a person´s appearance, relentless requests for personal details, statement of sexual comments and suggestions, public masturbation or flashing of private parts, groping, or any advances, whether verbal or physical, that is unwanted and has threatened one´s sense of personal space and physical safety.

Describes online sexual harassment as acts that use information and communications technology in terrorizing and intimidating victims through physical, psychological, and emotional threats, unwanted sexual and sexist remarks and comments online , invasion of victim´s privacy through cyber stalking and messaging, uploading and sharing of photos, voice, video without the consent of the victim and impersonating identities of victims online or posting lies that may harm the victim´s reputation, or filing false abuse reports to online platforms to silence victims. 

Prescribes penalties and equivalent fines for the violations of such unlawful acts. A victim of gender-based street, public spaces or online sexual harassment may avail of appropriate remedies as provided for under the law as well as psychological counselling services which fees shall be borne by the harasser.

Mandates the Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) for Metro Manila, the local units of the PNP for other provinces, and the Women and Children´s Protection Desk (WCPD) of the PNP to apprehend harassers and enforce the law provided that they have undergone prior Gender Sensitivity Training (GST).  The PCW, Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) and Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) shall be the national bodies responsible for the formulation of policies and overseeing the implementation of this Act.
rows.alias_name: “Safe Street, Public and Online Spaces Act.”

rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE NATIONAL MUSEUM OF THE PHILIPPINES, REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8492, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"NATIONAL MUSEUM ACT OF 1998\", AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Strengthening The National Museum Of The Philippines
rows.abstract:
Renames the National Museum as the “National Museum of the Philippines” or “Pambansang Museo ng Pilipinas.”

Prescribes the mandate, duties and functions of the National Museum.

Declares the whole Executive House known as the old Congress or Legislative Building, together with the Department of Finance Building and Department of Tourism as the permanent and exclusive site of the National Museum.  

Grants general public free admission to all public museums and national historical shrines and landmarks.

Allows the existing Museum Endowment Fund to continue to be utilized for the purpose of implementing special programs, projects and activities of the National Museum in furtherance of its mandate.

Authorizes the National Museum to retain the entirety of its income from all sources of its operations and to expend the same for any purpose in its benefit as may be authorized by its Board.
